blocks.text: Lots and land in Willoughby Heights

items.t: Compact lots (R-CL): the Residential Compact Lot zone is Willoughby's small-lot pattern, covering both front-loaded lots and rear-loaded lots with lane access. Lots run from 220 m² to 464.5 m² (5% of lots on a cul-de-sac bulb can be larger), with minimum frontage of 11 m for front-loaded lots and 8.2 m for rear-loaded lots (13.5 m and 12.5 m on corners), minimum depth of 18 m and 22 m, and no panhandle lots. Check which type a lot is: front-loaded or rear-loaded changes what to expect for garages, parking and lanes.

Tenure of the detached streets: freehold (fee-simple) — detached streets are freehold; condos and townhomes are strata under the Strata Property Act. A fee-simple lot carries no strata, no Form B and no strata fees.

Servicing: Willoughby is an urban growth area inside the Urban Containment Boundary, and every lot created by subdivision in the residential zones must meet the Township's Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw (2019, No. 5382).

ALR / flood: Willoughby is an urban growth area inside the Urban Containment Boundary. Yorkson Creek runs through the east side, and Township materials flag hazards around greenways and creeks in the plan area — check creek/greenway setbacks on east-side lots.

The bylaw allows it: the compact lot rules cover "all fee simple and bareland strata lots created by subdivision", so bare-land strata lots are possible on Willoughby's compact lots, at the same 220 to 464.5 m² sizes.

Willoughby Community Plan: Bylaw 1836 (1979), now Schedule 6 of Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025). The plan update makes the Transit Corridor the area's high-density spine. Land designated in the plan but not yet built isn't lots for sale.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Willoughby Heights

items.t: Willoughby Heights is in the Township of Langley. The Township calls the area "Willoughby"; "Willoughby Heights" is the real estate board's name for it. The name Willoughby was suggested for the post office at 208 Street and 83 Avenue, after an early settler named Willoughby.

Boundaries: the proposed Willoughby Community Plan (Bylaw No. 6201) describes the area as bordered by Surrey to the southwest, Highway 1 to the north, the Trans Mountain Pipeline ridgeline, Lower Mainland Regional Park and 68 Avenue to the south, and 216 Street and the Willowbrook Connector to the east. The older description, in Bylaw No. 3800, used 200 Street, 208 Street, Highway 1, 62 Avenue and Fraser Highway.

Main roads: Highway 1 runs along the north edge, with interchanges at 200, 208 and 216 Street. The main streets are 200 Street, 208 Street, 80 Avenue (Willoughby Way), 72, 76, 84 and 86 Avenue. Transit: route 501 (Surrey Central to Langley Centre via Fraser Highway and 200 Street), route 372 (Clayton Heights to Langley Centre via 72 Avenue) and route 595 (Langley Centre to Maple Ridge via the Golden Ears Bridge), with hubs at Langley Events Centre and Carvolth Exchange.

Mountain Secondary. Schools physically in Willoughby with SD35 addresses: Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, 7844 204B Street; Lynn Fripps Elementary, 21020 83 Avenue; Township statements also name Willoughby Elementary, Yorkson Creek Middle School and R.E. Mountain Secondary as Willoughby schools. Catchments are address-based — other addresses may differ, and no home is promised a specific school.
Post-secondary: Trinity Western University's Smith campus is at 8086 – 208 Street, and the university's campus expansion in southeast Willoughby is named in the Township's phase-1 background paper.

Market figures, September 2026: in Willoughby Heights, 100 detached homes were for sale and 13 sold (13%), and 369 condos and townhomes were for sale and 70 sold (19%). Langley's medians (Township and City combined) were $1,345,000 for detached homes and $611,000 for condos and townhomes.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Willoughby Heights

items.t: Zoning and plans: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 applies, including compact R-CL lots. The Willoughby Community Plan (originally Bylaw 1836, 1979) is now part of Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025).
Small-scale housing (Township): Bylaw 6020, adopted November 18, 2024, allows up to 4 units, with no six-unit tier. A secondary suite can be up to 120 m². The rules apply on eligible Willoughby lots.

Coach houses are fee simple, never strata: a coach house is a second home on a detached lot, never a townhouse complex. Sources disagree on suites in townhouses (the July 2025 bylaw allows them at 120 m²; the Township's January 2025 guide says no), so check with the Township. Willoughby's plans allow rear-lane coach houses on compact R-CL lots.

Strata rules (for the area's strata homes and any bare-land strata lot): read the Form B (fees, amounts owing, levies, contingency reserve balance and insurance summary; provided within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page). Since July 1, 2024, stratas with 5 or more lots need a depreciation report every 5 years, and since November 1, 2023 at least 10% of the budget must go into the contingency reserve. Rental restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022, so the "rentals not allowed" lines for Willow Park Estates and Highgate Terrace don't apply to long-term rentals. The only valid age bylaw is 55 and older, so a "45+" listing line isn't enforceable.

I don't know of any Agricultural Land Reserve land in Willoughby, so ALR rules aren't applied here. Where a Langley property is in the ALR: homes can't be stratified, subdividing needs Agricultural Land Commission approval, the main house can be up to 500 m² with a suite only inside it, and one additional home can be up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on larger ones. Farm tax status has three income tiers: $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha, $2,500 plus 5% of the land value over 4 ha, and $10,000 under 0.8 ha, with applications due by October 31.

blocks.text: Good to know about Willoughby Heights

items.t: Two wrong figures get passed around: 464.5 m² is the maximum lot area in the compact lot zone (with a 5% cul-de-sac exception), not a limit on a home's floor area, and a "355 m²" limit isn't in the bylaw at all. Pricing a Willoughby lot from either would get the land size wrong.

Willoughby's age-restricted complexes are older than the Willoughby most people picture: Willow Park Estates (1987) and Highgate Terrace (1990) were built decades before the area's current growth, at its southwest edge near Willowbrook. Highgate Terrace is age restricted, but its minimum age isn't published.

The plan area's boundary may change: the proposed Bylaw 6201 describes it as Highway 1 to the north, Surrey to the southwest, the pipeline ridgeline and 68 Avenue to the south, and 216 Street and the Willowbrook Connector to the east, which differs from the older Bylaw 3800 description. A lot near the edge can be inside one and outside the other.
The library that does check out: Muriel Arnason Library, 130 – 20338 65 Avenue (FVRL).

New construction homes for sale in Willoughby Heights

faq.q: How big is a Willoughby lot, really?
faq.a: In the compact lot zone (R-CL): lots of 220 to 464.5 m², frontage of at least 11 m (front-loaded) or 8.2 m (rear-loaded), depth of at least 18 m or 22 m, and no panhandle lots. Those are the rules for new lots in the zone; check the actual lot's size on title.

faq.q: Front-loaded or rear-loaded — why does it matter?
faq.a: It changes where the garage and parking sit, whether there is a lane, and the frontage/depth minimums that applied when the lot was created (11 m / 18 m vs 8.2 m / 22 m). Price lane access and parking accordingly.

faq.q: Is a coach house a strata unit I can buy separately?
faq.a: No. A coach house is a second home on the same fee-simple lot as the house; it's part of that property, never strata and never sold separately. Township sources differ on suites in townhouses (the bylaw as amended in July 2025 allows them; the January 2025 guide says no), so confirm with the Township before counting on a suite.

faq.q: Can I subdivide a Willoughby lot?
faq.a: Only against the zone table plus the Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw 2019 No. 5382 — and on R-CL lots of 220–464.5 m² there is no room left to split.

faq.q: How many units can I put on a detached lot?
faq.a: Township SSMUH is Bylaw 6020 (adopted Nov 18, 2024), and it has no six-unit tier; the secondary suite cap is 120 m². Check the lot's eligibility in the Township's SSMUH material.

faq.q: Can I buy just one side of a duplex in Willoughby Heights?
faq.a: Only if that side is legally separate — a strata lot in a 2-lot strata plan, or its own fee-simple lot. The Westbrooke row homes are the fee-simple case: Each unit is its own title. A single-lot duplex elsewhere sells whole. Check the title first.

faq.q: Is there a Willoughby duplex zone?
faq.a: The rules are the compact lot zone (R-CL, lots of 220 to 464.5 m²) plus the Township's small-scale housing bylaw.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Willoughby address?
faq.a: Mountain Secondary; other addresses may fall in different catchments, and Township sources also name Willoughby Elementary and Yorkson Creek Middle School as Willoughby schools.
